```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(knitr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
source("helper_functions.R")

selected_results_folder <- get_selected_results_folder("..", "report_config.yml")
selected_results_name <- basename(selected_results_folder)

# Extract forecast start date from folder name, e.g., 20260526_results
forecast_start_date <- as.Date(
gsub("_results", "", selected_results_name),
format = "%Y%m%d"
)

forecast_end_date <- forecast_start_date + 20

week1_start <- forecast_start_date
week1_end <- forecast_start_date + 6

week2_start <- forecast_start_date + 7
week2_end <- forecast_start_date + 13

week3_start <- forecast_start_date + 14
week3_end <- forecast_start_date + 20

fmt_date <- function(x) {
format(x, "%m/%d/%Y")
}
fmt_long_date <-function(x){
  format(x, "%B %d, %Y")
}
```

# Delta Real-Time Forecast Summary

Date Published: *`r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`*

Forecast Period: `r fmt_date(forecast_start_date)` – `r fmt_date(forecast_end_date)`

Forecast Week 1: `r fmt_date(week1_start)` – `r fmt_date(week1_end)`

Forecast Week 2: `r fmt_date(week2_start)` – `r fmt_date(week2_end)`

Forecast Week 3: `r fmt_date(week3_start)` – `r fmt_date(week3_end)`
